mapper.select: select count(1) from ods_user_account ua INNER JOIN ods_user u on (ua.user_id = u.id)

select dwbr.id, ua.user_id, u.pkg, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, ua.balance, ua.n1, ua.n2, ua.points, ua.transfer, now() update_time from ods_user_account ua INNER JOIN ods_user u on (ua.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (u.aid = uh.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_balance_record dwbr on (dwbr.user_id = ua.user_id) limit #{rows} OFFSET #{startRows}
